authority: Rohin175 supersedes Rohin173 propagation wait; preserves fixed C2 pilot172
baseline: observation -> specific changed action -> finding / uncertainty / next intention
delivery_rule: Per-life receipts bind actual rendered REQUEST, distinct from inbox publication; null means pending, not delivered
check_rule: three completed sleeps after first rendered arm turn; inspect each complete cycle; missing data is UNKNOWN, not failed
withdrawal_rule: after third completed arm sleep, no new parent or peer turns through one further completed sleep; pending old invitations remain visible and must be reported; no claim of clean-context withdrawal
retirement_rule: Preserve exact checkpoint, optimizer, RNG, context and journal before retiring an evidenced failing arm; no deletion, no retirement solely for missing observations
peer_rule: state summaries only, attributed and masked; recipient predicts/tests; only its own restatement trainable; pair assignment is not proof channel is active
causal_limit: Heterogeneous exploratory arms, not randomized matched estimates; historical controls and unchanged frozen controls do not automatically become matched modern-curriculum twins
